summary.text: David Rein is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the Democratic primary on June 30, 2026.
He is an attorney who, in a Ballotpedia survey, described himself as a city councilor in Lakewood.

paragraphs.text: David Rein earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota and a law degree from the University of Iowa College of Law, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Rein said he and his wife own a home in the community, send their children to local schools, and that he serves the community as a city councilor in Lakewood.

He listed expanding home ownership and stable housing, creating jobs with companies that treat workers with dignity, and stable K-12 education funding with expanded apprenticeship pathways as policy areas he is passionate about.
